## Summary

Discussion regarding the Account Based Sales and Marketing strategy finalized a 3 month engagement cycle for high value accounts.

---

## Refining Account Based Strategy

The team transitioned away from volume-based sales tactics to focus on high-value, multi-threaded relationships. This approach prioritizes sustainable engagement for large enterprise clients rather than transactional outreach.

## Establishing New Engagement Timeline

A decision was made to implement a 3 month cycle consisting of:
- 1 month for connecting
- 1 month for nurturing
- 1 month for pitching

This structure avoids aggressive outreach that often damages potential client relationships.

## Managing LinkedIn Platform Risks

Best practices include withdrawing connection requests after 30 days and limiting pending invites to maintain account health. These protocols ensure long-term stability and prevent platform penalties during complex outreach campaigns.

---

## Suggested Next Steps

- **[Ahmed Farhan]** Nurture existing connections: Prioritize nurturing established contacts instead of immediate lead generation. Utilize the current nurturing strategy for previous connections before initiating new outreach.
- **[The group]** Prune LinkedIn Connections: Remove pending connection requests until the total count is below 700 to prevent account de-prioritization by the algorithm.
- **[Farah Ibrahim]** Review ABSM Videos: Watch all available training materials to gain a thorough understanding of the relationship-building methodology.
